correctness.rationale: Model PG(2,3) as thirteen normalized 1D subspaces and their thirteen dual lines. A chosen point set S supports ∏_{p∈S} t_S(p) private-line assignments, each exactly an induced matching; summing over all 2^13 point sets gives polynomial coefficients (1,52,702,3276,5031,1404,234), total 10700. Independently reconstructed all 52 flags and enumerated 10700 independent flag configurations; maximal are exactly 1989 size-four and 234 size-six, while all 1404 size-five have one extension. Independent generator closure of PGL(3,3) and duality gave 11232 incidence automorphisms and twelve flag-matching orbits, three maximal orbits of sizes 117,1872,234. Independently checked tangent profiles, unique completion and orbits, not merely repository VERIFY_OK. Finite exhaustive proofs apply ONLY to this 26-vertex graph.

In particular, all 1404 five-flags extending in exactly one way and absence of maximal size-five systems are notable structural facts, beyond arbitrary isolated counts or known maximal-size bounds.
